sc_cat_item_producer.description:
Create New Course

 

This form allows Training Administrators to register new courses within the platform. Ensure that you provide a clear and concise name and a comprehensive description that covers the course objectives.

Integration Note: Once submitted, the process will automatically handle the translation of the description.
